| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(Cid) and isnotempty(DeviceId)

| where isnotempty(Cid) and isnotempty(Aid)
| join kind=inner (Hosts) on TenantId, Cid, Aid

relations.guidance: Compare non-empty token identifiers exactly and preserve case; never lowercase a UTI. One token can have many activity records. Keep actor, tenant, application, and time context, and include the originating sign-in in the lookback. A missing match can reflect retention or collection gaps. AAD Graph SignInActivityId is a best-effort token link. Exact equality can miss padded values. Remove only trailing Base64 padding on both sides and preserve case. This does not convert GUID-shaped IDs to Base64 or equate them with sign-in Id/CorrelationId. Inspect unmatched GUID-shaped values separately. TimeRequested is the request time; allow for delayed ingestion.
relations.kql:
let LeftEvents = AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| extend LeftKey = trim_end(@"=+", tostring(UniqueTokenIdentifier))
| where isnotempty(LeftKey);
let RightEvents = AADGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeRequested > ago(7d)
| extend RightKey = trim_end(@"=+", tostring(SignInActivityId))
| where isnotempty(RightKey);
LeftEvents
| join kind=inner (RightEvents) on $left.LeftKey == $right.RightKey
| project-away LeftKey, RightKey

DeviceEvents

| where isnotempty(DeviceId) and isnotempty(InitiatingProcessUniqueId)
| extend ProcessKey=InitiatingProcessUniqueId, ActivityTime=Timestamp
| join kind=inner (Processes) on TenantId, DeviceId, ProcessKey
| where ActivityTime >= ProcessStart

relations.guidance: Select the latest SecurityIncident record per IncidentName within the workspace before expanding AlertIds. Both incident history and alert updates can create duplicate results. let IncidentAlerts = SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TenantId, IncidentName
| mv-expand SystemAlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(SystemAlertId);
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(SystemAlertId)
| join kind=inner (IncidentAlerts) on SystemAlertId

| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(Id)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TenantId, Id;
ThreatIntelExportOperation
| where TimeExported > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(Id)
| join kind=inner (Intelligence) on TenantId, Id
relations.title: Connect exports to ThreatIntelObjects

relations.guidance: Enrich the initiating actor, not a target resource. User object IDs, application/client IDs, and service principal IDs are separate namespaces. Scope to the actual Entra tenant; AuditLogs.AADTenantId is the identity tenant. Snapshot metadata can repeat, so select the appropriate snapshot. These joins do not prove a shared session or token. Verify nested fields in collected records.
relations.kql:
let LeftEvents = AuditLogs
| where ActivityDateTime > ago(7d)
| extend JoinKey = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy)).app)).servicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(JoinKey);
let RightEvents = OAuthAppInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend JoinKey = tostring(ServicePrincipalId)
| where isnotempty(JoinKey);
LeftEvents
| join kind=inner (RightEvents) on JoinKey
relations.title: Enrich an audit initiator through app.servicePrincipalId

relations.guidance: The OAuth application/client ID and the service principal object ID are different namespaces. Scope service principal joins to the same tenant. App metadata can have multiple snapshots; select the relevant snapshot. A shared application enriches activity and does not establish a shared token or session. Use TimeRequested for request timing and allow for delayed ingestion. AADGraphActivityLogs.AADTenantId identifies the Entra tenant; its TenantId can identify the workspace. Use the actual identity tenant when narrowing enrichment. User and application actors use different fields; preserve ActorType when interpreting the result.

Id contains a feed prefix separated from the STIX ID by ---; Data.id and the relationship references are the global STIX identifiers. One object can participate in many relationships. Preserve source and target roles when interpreting matches.
relations.kql:
let Relationships = ThreatIntelObjects
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TenantId, Id
| where IsDeleted == false and StixType == "relationship"
| extend StixKey=tostring(Data.source_ref), FeedKey=tostring(split(Id, "---")[0])
| where isnotempty(StixKey);
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TenantId, Id
| where IsDeleted == false
| extend StixKey=tostring(Data.id), FeedKey=tostring(split(Id, "---")[0])
| where isnotempty(StixKey)
| join kind=inner (Relationships) on TenantId, FeedKey, StixKey
